Home/API Docs

API Documentation

ARENA USA exposes a small, stable public API. Authentication uses admin-issued API keys (Bearer tokens).

Authentication

All write endpoints require an API key issued by an ARENA USA administrator. Keys are scoped (e.g. ingest, read) and rate-limited per minute.

Send the key in one of three ways:

# Authorization header (recommended)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer arena_xxxxxxxx" https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/ingest

# X-Api-Key header
curl -H "X-Api-Key: arena_xxxxxxxx" https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/ingest

# Query string (less secure — only for quick testing)
curl "https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/ingest?api_key=arena_xxxxxxxx"

To obtain a key, an admin must sign in to the API Keys panel and generate one. Keys are shown exactly once at creation.

POST /api/ingest — Submit an article

The core endpoint. Used by third-party news parsers to submit articles. ARENA USA AI agents auto-classify, summarize, and check for duplicates before storage.

curl -X POST https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer arena_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady",
    "text":  "The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to maintain...",
    "url":   "https://example.com/source-article",
    "publishedAt": "2026-10-30T14:30:00Z",
    "coverImageUrl": "https://...",
    "categorySlug": "investing-banking",
    "tags": ["Federal Reserve", "Interest Rates"],
    "autoPublish": false
  }'

Response (201 Created):

{
  "ok": true,
  "duplicate": false,
  "articleId": "clk1abc...",
  "slug": "federal-reserve-holds-rates-steady-ab12",
  "status": "PENDING",
  "classification": {
    "primary_category": "investing-banking",
    "primary_category_name": "Investing & Banking",
    "subcategory": "Market Analysis",
    "editorial_confidence": 0.92,
    "moderation_recommendation": "publish"
  },
  "summary": {
    "proposed_title": "Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady",
    "concise_summary": "The FOMC voted unanimously to maintain the federal funds rate...",
    "key_claims": ["..."]
  }
}

Status values:

  • PENDING — default; an editor must approve before publication (recommended).
  • PUBLISHED — only when autoPublish=true AND moderation recommendation is publish.
  • REJECTED — auto-rejected by moderation rules (sensitive content detected).

Duplicate detection: if the same content hash or a very similar title already exists, the API returns 200 with "duplicate": true and the existing article ID. No new record is created.

GET /api/articles — Public feed

Returns published articles within the 48-hour retention window (or pinned forever).

curl "https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/articles?category=investing-banking&limit=20"

Query parameters:

  • category — filter by category slug (e.g. politics, technology-ai)
  • limit — page size, default 20, max 100
  • cursor — publishedAt ISO timestamp for pagination
  • includeBreaking — include breaking news (default true)

GET /api/categories — Taxonomy

Returns the canonical 16-category ARENA USA taxonomy.

curl https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/categories

POST /api/heartbeat — Visitor counter

Internal endpoint used by the live visitor counter. Sends a heartbeat every 30 seconds while the page is visible. Returns the count of sessions active in the last 60 seconds.

POST /api/heartbeat
{ "sessionId": "s_...", "path": "/article/..." }

→ { "activeCount": 1284, "ok": true }

GET /api/health — System status

Public health check. Returns 503 if the database is unreachable.

curl https://arena-usa.vercel.app/api/health

Rate limits & error handling

  • Default rate limit: 60 requests per minute per API key (configurable).
  • Exceeding the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests.
  • Invalid or disabled keys return 401 / 403.
  • Validation errors return 422 with a descriptive message.
  • All write operations are logged in the audit trail.

Edge Runtime compatibility

ARENA USA AI agents run on TypeScript Edge Runtime inside Next.js route handlers — there are no Python workers. This means the entire platform (frontend + API + AI pipeline) deploys to Vercel from a single GitHub repository.

Agents implemented in Phase 1:

  • classifyAgent — maps raw text → category + moderation signal
  • summarizeAgent — generates concise original summary
  • dedupeAgent — content hash + title similarity check
  • contentHashFor — SHA-256 idempotency key

Phase 2 will layer an LLM call (via Vercel AI SDK) on top of these extractive heuristics for higher-quality summaries and editorial decisions.
